summary: Cited the revised availability harness (receipt 7ac7e4f67d194ad5b4e196c9b73f9897) in the replay-completion account, removing the account's dependence on a single replication batch size for the availability consequence. That receipt records a prefix with 9000 committed commands at Config.MaxAppendEntries 64 (event 15: staged commit index 9001, 141 entry-based batches, snapshot index 0), the replay-enabled restart not returning with two stack samples naming the replay frames (event 16), and the outcome at event 17 - the group committed while two members were live and lost that ability after the second stop, which the comparison marked violated. Alongside the three earlier executions at batch size 16 this gives four executions of the availability split across two batch sizes, and the limitation that named a single batch size is corrected. joint_history records that the receipt is a revision of the availability experiment whose harness adds the default-batch case to the same file, so it re-observes the earlier cases and also contains the authority and vote cases the configuration-recovery investigation relies on; sources, the other executions, knowledge uses, conclusion and counterevidence are unchanged.
